Metadata.Goal: 以 WorkCtrlFlow 真正执行并恢复 AICtrlWorkflow。
Metadata.Description: 资源解析、workflow fact store、Eidolon effects 和真实 run tools。

TaskSpace.name: execute-ai-ctrl-workflow-through-eidolon-runtime
TaskSpace.Description: Canonical ctrl runtime over Eidolon effects and persistence.

TaskGroup.name: Runtime resources and facts
TaskGroup.Description: Resolve definitions and persist reconstructable ctrl workflow facts.

Task.name: Add definition repository and base URI loading
Task.Description: Resolve resource/vfs refs under runtime workspace and load canonical binding with bundle base URI.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Resource and VFS refs resolve containment-safely to one canonical ctrl binding

Task.name: Add persistent ctrl workflow fact stores
Task.Description: Persist descriptors, WorkCtrlFlow snapshots and workflow events atomically.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: A fresh service instance reconstructs status/resume from stored facts

TaskGroup.name: Controller and Eidolon effects
TaskGroup.Description: Execute canonical controller with embedded host adapters.

Task.name: Add Eidolon workflow effect provider
Task.Description: Map tool/actor/material operations to existing authorities and lifecycle evidence.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Effects call existing adapters and emit request/result/failure evidence when sessionDir exists

Task.name: Add ctrl runtime service start/status/resume
Task.Description: Create/rebuild controllers and expose stable ctrl projections.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Completed and waiting graphs project real node records
Matching resume signals complete persisted waiting runs idempotently

TaskGroup.name: Run tool adoption and verification
TaskGroup.Description: Route public tools to real ctrl service and verify recovery/evidence.

Task.name: Adopt service in workflow runtime tools
Task.Description: Replace opaque delegate run while preserving legacy detached reads.

Task.name: Run ctrl runtime verification
Task.Description: Run completed/wait/resume/recovery/effect tests, builds and authority scans.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests prove WorkCtrlFlow execution and no opaque prompt fallback for new runs
